correctness.rationale: The exposed opposite-sign pair condition requires both grid indices distinct; the same-sign faces are Cartesian products of simplices and give rook edges, so each of 2pq vertices has degree pq-1. The adjacency matrix is [[R,S],[S,R]], where R is rook adjacency and S=(J_p-I_p) tensor (J_q-I_q). Even/odd diagonalization and eigenvalues p-1,-1 and q-1,-1 of the tensor factors give all six eigenvalue families with multiplicities totaling 2pq, one zero. Kirchhoff gives the exact tree product; comparison of odd-block entries gives the spectral gap and the exceptional p=q=2 multiplicity 3. Independently constructed Laplacians for (p,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,3) match the exact characteristic polynomials and cofactors, including 384 trees at (2,2). These finite checks supplement the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: Complete-bipartite symmetric edge polytopes are classical lattice polytope families with extensive facet/Ehrhart study. Their graph-theoretic Laplacian, complete multiplicities, tree complexity, and Fiedler transition (uniform gap for p=2 versus growing balanced gap) form a natural two-parameter connectivity classification not furnished by the known defining-graph tree counts.
